scope: Whole report read; internal-method review, limited primary-source checks and current-beta sanity check. Not a full reproduction.

findings.finding: Credit proxies contradict available HY observations in 4/6 recent analogs
findings.evidence: Table 3b: Dec 2023 -41bp; May 2024 -6bp; Jan 2025 -13bp; Sep 2025 -4bp HY OAS, despite proxy-widening classification. Feb 2026 +21bp and Jun 2026 +3bp agree.
findings.implication: Proxy-defined analogs are not six independently confirmed credit-stress rebounds. Current reported HY widening is distinct.

findings.finding: Strongest relative-return result lacks displayed phase robustness
findings.evidence: Table 1f shows absolute KRE returns only. The headline claim is KRE minus KBWB.
findings.implication: Require relative-return means, medians, counts and uncertainty across all phases; do not infer robustness from absolute-return tests. Phase variants are dependent.

findings.finding: Real-yield decomposition does not identify term premium or cause
findings.evidence: Section 3 moves from unchanged breakevens to a claim of real-yield and term-premium decline and a flight-to-quality mechanism. No term-premium estimates presented.
findings.implication: Retain observed real-yield decomposition; label growth fear and safe-haven causes as hypotheses. Stable ten-year inflation compensation does not rule out near-term disinflation.

findings.finding: AOCI mechanism asserted more strongly than cross-section permits
findings.evidence: Section 3 says same mechanism and because yields fall; section 4 finds HTM losses are not a differential falling-yield exposure.
findings.implication: AOCI relief remains possible but unproven; cross-sectional null neither establishes nor excludes a shared sector effect.

findings.finding: Statistical precision and causal language require narrowing
findings.evidence: 394 primary tests; nested cells; 8 falling-yield days; HC3 does not address arbitrary cross-bank dependence. Mapping mistakes need not be unbiased.
findings.implication: Effect sizes are exploratory. Clarify whether models aggregate by stock or pool observations; use suitable dependence-aware uncertainty and leave-event-out sensitivity.

findings.evidence: June fundamentals used for returns beginning July 1, April-October sensitivity; June filings not necessarily public at start.
findings.implication: Label descriptive associations or use publication-lagged data for predictive claims. Current holdings introduce additional selection concerns.

findings.finding: CATO single-factor R2 discrepancy remains open
findings.evidence: Section 0 re-estimates a two-factor model and speculates about alignment; it does not reconcile the earlier single-factor KBWB/IWM/SPY mismatch.
findings.implication: Obtain exact dates, return and yield definitions, missing-value policy, intercept and implementation.

findings.finding: Dissenter names are directly available in the Fed statement
findings.evidence: Official October 28 statement names Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack and their preference for a quarter-point increase.
Size coefficients +9.6 and -5.2 imply a 14.8bp difference, but cell shows +3.9, apparently t only.
findings.implication: Print coefficient and t separately; do not assume arithmetic error.

findings.finding: GFC rate-beta explanation mixes conditional and unconditional behavior
findings.evidence: Negative SPY-controlled beta is explained with simultaneous falling yields and bank stress; these are different statistical relationships.
findings.implication: Distinguish conditional rate sensitivity from raw co-movement.

local_sanity_check.method: Last 63 saved ETF daily returns; intercept + SPY return + FRED DGS10 daily change in percentage points. FRED snapshot, not report Treasury par dataset.
local_sanity_check.limit: Supports sign and approximate magnitude only. Not independent vendor validation or exact replication. Missing source rows prevent identical sample.

assessment: Useful descriptive extension. Shared negative bank rate sensitivity is supported by a limited local check. Historical relative underperformance remains an unreplicated hypothesis; no reliable absolute-direction forecast or causal mechanism established. No trade, owner grade or standing monitoring changed.
